headline: It’s Greg Brockman’s OpenAI now
summary: Greg Brockman's role at OpenAI is expanding amidst a turbulent year. OpenAI faced lawsuits from Elon Musk and Apple, plus scrutiny over an AI model. The company is preparing for an IPO following executive shifts.

headline: This app makes the Pixel 11’s HiLight feature actually useful
summary: The Pixel 11 Pro's new HiLight notification LED has limited out-of-box uses. It only glows for Gemini interactions or favorite contact calls. A new app aims to make this feature genuinely useful.

headline: LG’s 65-inch B6 OLED is $300 lower than its previous best price
summary: Best Buy is offering significant discounts on LG products for its Deal of the Day. The 65-inch LG B6 OLED TV is now $1,399.99, a new low price. This deal saves buyers $600 off the original price.

headline: Amazon’s drone deliveries are landing in pools and ponds
summary: Amazon's drone delivery service is expanding to 500 US cities. Drones are reportedly dropping packages into pools and ponds. A video showed a drone depositing a package into a Texas customer's pool.

headline: Marvel Addresses the Greatest Flaw of Civil War 20 Years Later
summary: Marvel's "Civil War" storyline, in both comics and film, had a key flaw: the conflict eventually ended. A new series is now addressing this issue two decades later. This aims to explore the lasting impact of the original conflict.

headline: FromSoftware Isn't Done With Single-Player Games, Miyazaki Reassures
summary: Despite upcoming multiplayer titles like "Elden Ring: Nightreign" and "The Duskbloods," FromSoftware's Miyazaki reassures fans. He confirms the studio remains committed to developing single-player experiences. This news calms fears about a shift away from their core single-player RPGs.

headline: Best Buy Is Offering a Free $10 Gift Card With These Game Preorders
summary: Best Buy is offering a special preorder bonus for select major Fall game releases. Customers can receive a free $10 gift card with qualifying preorders. This makes Best Buy the exclusive retailer for this offer.

headline: Best Buy Is Selling $100 Gift Cards for $60 in Stores This Weekend
summary: Best Buy will sell $100 gift cards for just $60 this weekend. This special offer is available during a 24-hour in-store sale only. Shoppers can save significantly on future Best Buy purchases.

headline: Harry and Meghan's security arrangements a private matter, PM says
summary: The Prime Minister stated that Prince Harry and Meghan's security arrangements are a private matter. This comes as the Duke and Duchess are set to return to the UK later this month. The PM also extended well wishes to the couple.

headline: Why are Harry and Meghan returning to the UK?
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan's upcoming return to the UK raises several questions. Concerns include their security arrangements and potential royal duties. There's also speculation about Harry's relationship with King Charles and Prince William.

headline: Five key takeaways from GCSE results day 2026
summary: Key trends emerged from the 2026 GCSE results day. The number of exam resits has increased across the board. The performance gap between boys and girls has narrowed significantly. However, England's regional educational divide has unfortunately widened.

headline: Man charged over Manchester synagogue attack
summary: A man has been charged in connection with a Manchester synagogue attack. Police accuse him of failing to disclose information related to terrorist activity. Further details about the alleged activity were not immediately released.
